decision: Should gaia dev provenance, evidence-seed, assess and prefill require Verifier authorization like the other mutating dev verbs?
whyItMatters: Who may write registry-adjacent state is authorization policy. The mutation-boundary sensor found these verbs write files with no require_operator gate.
evidence: dev provenance writes the provenance ledger via os.makedirs + write_text with no require_operator (confidence 0.7).
dev assess and prefill write advisory receipts via _atomic_write_json; these may be intentionally ungated.
The legacy MUTATING_DEV_COMMANDS in impl.py lacks six verbs the live set gates (calibrate-trust-magnitude, embed, freeze, fuse, ratify, sync-upstream).
recommended: Gate provenance and evidence-seed; keep assess/prefill ungated as advisory receipts and record that as intentional.
alternative: Keep all four ungated and record each as an intentional exception.
unblocks: Closing the ungated_mutation debt either by a gate change (Class B proposal) or by recorded exemptions.
